issues.description: The template's example usage in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java calls farm.feed(), while the problem statement and the solution expect a method named feedAllAnimals(). This name mismatch between the template example and the specified API can confuse students about the correct method to implement and use.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Main.java example to call farm.feedAllAnimals() (or adjust the problem statement/solution to consistently use feed() if that name is preferred). Ensure all references (template, problem text, and solution) use the same method name to avoid student confusion.

issues.description: The concept 'feed all animals' is referred to with two different method names across artifacts: the Problem Statement and Solution use feedAllAnimals(), while the template's commented Main uses feed(). This creates a mapping confusion for students who look at the provided Main and expect a method feed(), but the task description and reference implementation require feedAllAnimals().
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent. Update the template Main.java comment to call farm.feedAllAnimals() instead of farm.feed(), or provide a short alias method feed() in Farm that delegates to feedAllAnimals() (e.g., public void feed() { feedAllAnimals(); }) so both names work and students are not confused.
